metadata.name: bordrless_router
metadata.description: Bordrless router: an app's integrator fee on any Bordrless DEX swap. It takes the fee (at most 1%) from the trade's quote side, a buy's input before the swap or a sell's output after it, pays the integrator and Bordrless's share of it (20%) to the DEX config's treasury, and runs the DEX's own swap unchanged in between.

instructions.name: swap
docs: A DEX swap with an integrator's fee. Remaining accounts: the DEX swap's own, exactly as
`bordrless_swap::client::swap` lists them (the trader signing).

accounts.name: trader
docs: The trader: signs the DEX swap and the fee's transfer.

instructions.name: swap_v2
docs: `swap` on a native pool, through the DEX's `swap_v2`: the trader pays a buy's fee from its
wallet, and a sell, delivered to the trader's wallet, pays it from what arrived; the
integrator and the DEX treasury are paid SOL to their wallets. Remaining accounts: the DEX
`swap_v2`'s own, exactly as `bordrless_swap::client::swap_v2` lists them.

accounts.name: trader
docs: The trader: signs the DEX swap and pays the fee from its wallet.

accounts.name: integrator
docs: above the rent-exempt minimum).

errors.name: BadFee
errors.msg: an integrator fee is 1 to 100 basis points, and a buy must keep some input to swap

errors.name: SwapAccounts
errors.msg: the remaining accounts must be the DEX swap's own, the router's trader signing first

errors.name: QuoteHasHook
errors.msg: the pool's quote mint has a token hook: the router takes fees in a quote without one

errors.name: NotTradersHolding
errors.msg: the swap's quote holding must be the trader's own: a routed sell delivers to the trader

errors.name: WrongTreasury
errors.msg: the treasury holding must be the DEX config's treasury's holding of the quote

errors.name: WrongIntegratorHolding
errors.msg: the integrator's holding must be a holding of the pool's quote, not the trader's nor the pool's

errors.name: Slippage
errors.msg: what the trader keeps after the fee is under its floor

errors.name: WrongProgram
errors.msg: a program account is not the expected program

errors.name: RecipientBelowRent
errors.msg: a fee recipient would be left below the rent-exempt minimum

types.name: IntegratorFeePaid
docs: A routed swap paid an integrator's fee.

fields.name: integrator
docs: The owner of the integrator's holding paid.

fields.name: direction
docs: 0 a sell, 1 a buy.

fields.name: charged_on
docs: What the fee was taken of: a buy's whole input, a sell's delivery.

fields.name: fee
docs: The whole fee, and Bordrless's share of it (the integrator got the rest).

types.name: RouterSwapArgs
docs: Arguments of `swap`.

fields.name: swap
docs: The DEX swap's own arguments; a buy's `amount_in` is the trader's whole input, the fee
included (the DEX swaps it less the fee).

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: The integrator's fee: 1 to `MAX_FEE_BPS` basis points of the trade's quote side.

fields.name: min_quote_after_fee
docs: A sell's floor on what the trader keeps after the fee (the DEX's `min_amount_out` bounds
what arrives before it); unused on a buy.

types.name: SwapArgs
docs: Arguments of `swap`.

fields.name: direction
docs: 0 base → quote (a sell), 1 quote → base (a buy).

fields.name: amount_in
docs: Exact input.

fields.name: min_amount_out
docs: The least the recipient's holding must gain.

fields.name: in_hook_accounts
docs: Remaining accounts of the input mint's token hook (its program, the token program's
signer for it, its extras; none without a hook).

fields.name: out_hook_accounts
docs: Remaining accounts of the output mint's token hook (likewise).

fields.name: hook_data
docs: Opaque data for the pool hook.
